title: The terms of (2 + x)⁵
caption: The coefficient of xᵏ is C(5, k) × 2⁵⁻ᵏ: 32, 80, 80, 40, 10, 1. For x³ it is C(5, 3) × 2² = 40. They add to 3⁵ = 243, the value at x = 1.
alt: Bar chart of the coefficients of x⁰ to x⁵ in (2 + x)⁵: 32, 80, 80, 40, 10, 1; the bar for x³ is highlighted.
description: The term in xᵏ is C(5, k) × 2⁵⁻ᵏ × xᵏ.
